maya: Quick follow-up from the kernel-autotune RFC — thinking about using a smoothed seq-len histogram + micro-batch packing to reduce kernel churn on tail queries.
samir: +1. Can you sketch the smoothing math? worried about oscillations when traffic shifts quickly.
maya: Idea: maintain EWMA over per-tenant seqlen buckets, alpha=0.15 by default. Keep ephemeral probe bucket for spikes. Pseudocode:
```
for b in buckets:
  hist[b] = alpha * observed[b] + (1-alpha)*hist[b]
```
Then derive bucket thresholds at cumulative percentiles (50/90/99) from smoothed hist.
samir: ok, makes sense. How do we handle warmup / KV cache priming for newly selected kernels?
liz: Proposal: micro-probes (3 small requests) that run in low-priority lane to populate KV & kernel paths. If probe success hit ratio > 0.6 then mark warmed.
oliver: micro-probes sound fine, but avoid costing customers. Put probes under trial credits + only on Dedicated/private by default.
maya: Agreed — also add a knob `autotune.probe_budget_per_min=2` and `autotune.probe_ttl=15m`.
carla: What about packing? If seqlen distribution is wide we should prefer pad-aware packing: pack similar lengths in short windows (50ms) and fall back to async micro-batching for long tails.
samir: We should record metrics: bucket_assignment_rate, probe_success_rate, kernel_switch_count, p99_kernelswitch_latency. Also cost_delta_per_hour when probing.
runtime-bot: deploy-bot: Started canary `autotune/smoothing-v1` in us-west-2 on 3 nodes.
maya: Nice. For experiments let's run A/B with smoothing alpha={0.05,0.15,0.3} and probe_budget={0,1,3}. Measure p50/p95/p99 latency, token cost, cache hit.
liz: One more: persist per-model 'shape-hint' in runtime-state store so rollout can resume after restart. TTL 7d by default.
oliver: Concern — model upgrades change optimal kernels. We need to tag hints with model_hash and invalidate on model change.
maya: Good catch. Will add model_hash and platform_epoch to hint key.
samir: Cool. Can someone open a lightweight RFC PR with the experiment matrix and metrics? I can help with dashboards.
maya: I'll open the PR today and add a small opt-in flag. Thanks all :thumbsup:
